_comment: Hot swap out (scripts/ci/piece_swap.py; cmuxterm-hq docs/design/cmux-next-hot-swap-layers.md, 'Hot swap out'). When the post-merge batch's bisect names one first-red commit and every piece of it is in a class listed here, the revert job swaps out pieces of that commit before any whole revert: it drills down (statically by the red suite's own paths, then by halves, one probe run each) to the one piece, opens a pull request that takes back only that piece, tells the commit's PR once, and prints the whole revert as the owner's fallback command (never performed). A commit with a class not listed keeps today's whole revert pull request. Classes come from .github/change-classes.json. Ships with only the drill class, so it changes nothing on feat-cmux-next. One switch stops it: the repository variable NEXT_PIECE_SWAP=0 (no commit). Add a class to the list to turn it on for that class.
